title: Ouro jail receipt v1
description: Frozen at jail milestone 1 (jail-v1 §13.2, §17). The shared shape, phase tuples and coverage invariants. The rules JSON Schema cannot state (native byte strings, unique ids and keys, gap interval order) are ouro_jail::records::semantic and validate_contract.py over fixtures/semantic-cases.json. lifetime.boundary is a per-OS vocabulary: pid_namespace and supervisor_cgroup on Linux, native_tree elsewhere.

allOf.$comment: jail-v1.md:1555-1558 and :1574-1575 (§11.4): a class is active only once its source was applied; an active audit class means the observer attached for this attempt and the audit source is active or degraded.
jail-v1.md:1561-1562 (§11.4): proxy.net can be active only for an applied proxy.
jail-v1.md:1872 and :1876-1879 (§13.2): in a refusal before boundary creation every applied field is unapplied, and the network mode is pending (host for none, which the containment rules bind).
jail-v1.md:1837, :1872 and :1876-1878 (§13.2): containment is pending only before the final policy is established, which is a refusal before boundary creation, where the network mode is pending.
jail-v1.md:1638-1642 (§11.4): any evidence class degraded in the observer's final account is an evidence_lost error, whatever the evidence mode.
jail-v1.md:1555-1558, :1563-1564 and :1636-1637 (§11.4), :1830 (§13.2): a degraded class states its missing interval as at least one explicit gap.
